name: UK Biobank
data_domain: genomic clinical imaging biomarker health data
granularity_model: data tiers; RAP platform by default; limited exemptions; formerly some downloads
controls: eligibility review; Access Committee; MTA; no re-identification; no unauthorized sharing; annual reporting; data tier requests
monitoring_or_logs: RAP cloud environment; output-checking procurement planned; annual reports; publication reporting
post_access_actions: project discontinuation or update after material organization change; higher-tier request; completion and returned data
incident_outcomes_available: not systematic public incident register; policy violations likely confidential
research_value_outcomes_available: publications; returned datasets; derived variables; peer-reviewed paper counts; project register
denominators_available: existing projects; over 22000 researchers; over 18000 papers; application schema
potential_policy_events: Q2 2024 RAP by default; Jan 2025 no direct insurance-company access; 2025 RAP2/output-checking procurement; 2026 application pause
comparison_potential: strong before/after within UKB if data by project/tier/status can be obtained; cross-institution comparator to All of Us or OpenSAFELY
overall_assessment: high priority but project-status gaps must be resolved
next_steps: In Phase 2 seek downloadable project register history; RAP exemption policy; output-checking implementation dates; aggregate applications/approvals/withdrawals by year

name: NIH dbGaP and CADRs
granularity_model: controlled versus unrestricted access; dataset-specific DACs; DUC terms
controls: Signing Official review; DAC review; Data Use Certification; security best practices; incident reporting
monitoring_or_logs: access request statuses; repository/user security standards; possible logs at CADRs; DAC review statuses
post_access_actions: approval expiration; renewal; revision requested; revocation possible under code of conduct
incident_outcomes_available: data management incidents are defined but public incident list not obvious
research_value_outcomes_available: citations/publications by accession may be recoverable through PubMed and dbGaP metadata
denominators_available: study metadata; DACs; some accession/publication links; not request denominator publicly
potential_policy_events: Jan 25 2025 updated user security standards; Feb 25 2026 CADR security/operational standards; Nov 1 2025 standard access process requirements
comparison_potential: good policy event across repositories but access-decision microdata likely unavailable; useful calibration and institutional comparison
next_steps: In Phase 2 inventory CADR list and test whether dbGaP metadata exposes study release dates and publications at scale

name: All of Us Research Program
data_domain: EHR survey wearable genomic and participant data
granularity_model: Public tier; Registered tier; Controlled tier with genomics and finer demographics/dates
controls: identity verification; DURA; Responsible Conduct training; Data User Code of Conduct; data passport; workspace descriptions public
monitoring_or_logs: access logged and may be audited; Resource Access Board; workspace audits
post_access_actions: account termination; sanctions; public violator posting option; NIH notification; project review request by public
incident_outcomes_available: violations not obviously public; review requests may not be transparent
research_value_outcomes_available: public project directory; publications linked to workspaces; research highlights
denominators_available: active project directory; dataset tier field; researcher/institution/project purpose fields
potential_policy_events: Controlled Tier expansion and Workbench migration; June 2026 migration completion; account management policy update
comparison_potential: very promising project-level denominator and tier comparison; less clear policy shock
next_steps: In Phase 2 assess project directory exportability/API; collect counts by tier/time; link publications

name: NHS England Secure Data Environment
data_domain: NHS health and social care data
granularity_model: SDE access instead of data extracts; pseudonymized/minimized patient-level data; outputs aggregate
controls: DARS application; Five Safes; Advisory Group for Data; Safe Output Service; Data Release Register; charges
monitoring_or_logs: safe output workflow; VDI tools; output/import tool; three-working-day target; third-party audits
post_access_actions: output approved/rejected; access limited to permitted data; penalties for bypass; registration status
incident_outcomes_available: output rejection and penalties not aggregate public; Data Release Register may show flows
research_value_outcomes_available: research outputs possibly via project-specific reports; Data Release Register; publications external
denominators_available: Data Release Register; registered organizations promised; platform data products
potential_policy_events: 2022 SDE default policy guidelines; Apr 1 2026 SDE Network registration service; 2026 output-service guidance
comparison_potential: excellent governance setting but public project-level outcome data may be fragmented
next_steps: In Phase 2 inspect Data Release Register structure and regional SDE registers; seek output metrics or annual reports

name: OpenSAFELY
data_domain: primary care EHR and linked NHS data
granularity_model: code runs against pseudonymized data in situ; researchers see aggregate outputs; no raw patient data
controls: approved projects; GitHub code; open logs; Airlock; manual output checking by two checkers; small-number suppression
monitoring_or_logs: public logs where possible; job server; output requests tracked; output check audit trail
post_access_actions: release approved; approved subject to change; rejected; access revoked when project finishes
incident_outcomes_available: output-check issues may contain rejection/modification traces; no raw leakage incidents
research_value_outcomes_available: over 95 completed papers; research page links papers and source code; over 200 projects claimed on homepage
denominators_available: projects; papers; code repositories; public logs and output releases
potential_policy_events: 2025 Pilot Directions allowed non-COVID research; Jan 2026 Optum access temporarily closed; 2026 annual licence fee/new submissions window
comparison_potential: very strong for mechanism illustration and possibly event-history of output release; not classic seller-buyer market
next_steps: In Phase 2 test public job server/GitHub issue data fields manually; map projects to publications and output-check events

name: ONS Secure Research Service and UKSA RAP
granularity_model: secure setting access to de-identified unpublished data; approved safe settings; metadata catalogue restrictions
controls: accredited researchers; accredited projects; accredited processors; Five Safes; output checking; public benefit and ethics criteria
monitoring_or_logs: SRS management information; quarterly project counts; accredited processing environments; output checking
post_access_actions: accreditation can be withdrawn; project accreditation duration; output release checks
incident_outcomes_available: suspensions/removals not clearly public; incidents likely confidential
research_value_outcomes_available: project transparency; outputs expected open and accessible; publications may be external
denominators_available: 868 current projects and 254 started in last 12 months as of July 2026; public accredited project register
potential_policy_events: Research Accreditation Panel assumed expanded oversight 2021; data capability accreditation revised 2022; IDS replacing SRS in progress
comparison_potential: very promising denominator and processing-environment comparison; direct leakage outcomes weak
next_steps: In Phase 2 download project register and processing environment list; code projects by protected data and environment

name: CMS / ResDAC / CCW VRDC
data_domain: Medicare Medicaid and CMS administrative data
granularity_model: LDS versus RIF; secure download/encrypted media/VRDC; aggregate-only VRDC outputs
controls: DUA; IRB/HIPAA waiver; data management plan; CMS cell suppression; output review
monitoring_or_logs: VRDC output review; DMP SAQ; extension reporting; media disposition certificates
post_access_actions: DUA amendment; extension; closure; output review limits; destruction requirements
incident_outcomes_available: HIPAA breaches separate; CMS data-use incidents not public
research_value_outcomes_available: extension form will collect publicly disseminated findings; publications can be externally linked
denominators_available: no project register; data request processing timelines; output review limits
potential_policy_events: Feb 11 2026 policy update; Aug 11 2026 DMP SAQ/extension/media rules; 2026 monthly VRDC updates
comparison_potential: good policy shock but public project data weak; valuable for welfare trade-off via access friction
next_steps: In Phase 2 inspect RIF/LDS DUA forms and whether extension findings become public; track professional responses

name: Statistics Canada RDC and vRDC
granularity_model: RDC physical secure labs; vRDC/remote access; RTRA aggregate remote outputs
controls: deemed employee; security clearance; mandatory training; oath of secrecy; peer review; agreements
monitoring_or_logs: output vetting by Statistics Canada employees; VDL monitoring controls and vetting tools
post_access_actions: agreement start/end; add/remove co-investigators; final product obligation; linkage approvals
research_value_outcomes_available: final product required; RDC research outcomes at some local RDCs; publications and theses
denominators_available: user counts and KPI baselines in evaluation; program-level access stats possible
potential_policy_events: 2020 Virtual Data Lab pilot/evaluation; continuing vRDC modernization
comparison_potential: good comparative TRE setting; Canada-specific legal structure; project data may be dispersed
next_steps: In Phase 2 search CRDCN project/publication data and current vRDC statistics

name: CASD
data_domain: administrative statistical health business and linked confidential data
granularity_model: secure bubble; SD-Box; centralized project server; no file retrieval except checked outputs
controls: GDPR certification; ISO 27001/27701; HDS; CNIL; producer approvals; statistical secrecy committee
monitoring_or_logs: SD-Box authentication; resource logs implied; output checks; secure download link; copies retained for ex post checks
post_access_actions: project prolongation; add sources; add researchers; output release; on-site SD-Box visits
research_value_outcomes_available: 400+ publications and communications; hosted project list; data sources
potential_policy_events: June 2026 SD-Box site visits; 2026 France-Germany pilot for joint secure environment
comparison_potential: strong institution-level denominators and controls; weaker incident outcomes
next_steps: In Phase 2 query CDAP hosted projects manually and assess whether project dates/users/publications are exportable

name: EGA
granularity_model: public metadata; controlled file access; DAC-specific DAAs; download after approval
controls: Data Access Committees; DAC Portal; policy objects; DUO terms; encryption; identity assurance
monitoring_or_logs: access-right changes; request logs; resource-usage logs; DAC request history
post_access_actions: grant; deny; active permission; revoke; expiration; account on hold for suspected misuse
incident_outcomes_available: not public except possibly DAC decisions; EGA can place accounts on hold
research_value_outcomes_available: publication links by dataset/study may be recoverable; public metadata
denominators_available: studies; datasets; DACs; samples; public metadata
potential_policy_events: DAC Portal and API maturation; evolving GA4GH security practices
comparison_potential: excellent conceptual match to theory but distributed DACs limit public decision data
next_steps: In Phase 2 sample EGA API metadata for requestable fields; identify a subset with rich publication links

name: NCI Cancer Data Access System
granularity_model: study-specific data and biospecimen requests; some images/specimens; approved projects
controls: request review; study-specific approvals; public approved project summaries
monitoring_or_logs: not clearly monitoring-heavy; project approval and publication tracking
post_access_actions: request approved; biospecimen verification; project outputs
research_value_outcomes_available: approved projects and CDAS publications pages
denominators_available: approved projects; publications; study availability dates
potential_policy_events: study-specific application rounds and data releases
comparison_potential: good research-value source; weaker monitoring/adaptive granularity mechanism
next_steps: In Phase 2 inspect approved project fields and publication linkage for one or two CDAS studies

name: Commercial clean rooms (AWS Snowflake Google Ads Data Hub)
data_domain: advertising commercial customer and partner data
granularity_model: query templates; aggregation thresholds; differential privacy; analysis rules; privacy budgets
controls: collaborator approval; query controls; output controls; query logs; privacy checks
monitoring_or_logs: query logs; template approvals; budget monitoring; difference checks
post_access_actions: query rejection; template approval/rejection; output row filtering; budget exhaustion
incident_outcomes_available: private to customers; no public incidents
research_value_outcomes_available: business insight outcomes private; no project/publication register
denominators_available: no public denominator beyond product docs
potential_policy_events: Snowflake legacy clean-room migration 2026-10-01 to 2027-06-01; product feature changes
comparison_potential: mainly taxonomy and calibration analog; not a primary empirical design
next_steps: Use as institutional-control taxonomy input; do not prioritize unless transparency reports emerge

name: GitHub public code ecosystem
data_domain: source code repositories public packages secrets copyright notices
granularity_model: public repositories; takedown notices; secret scanning detection scope; push protection
controls: DMCA policy; secret scanning; partner alerts; public monitoring; push protection
monitoring_or_logs: automated scanning; provider webhooks; validity checks; public monitoring alerts for enterprises
post_access_actions: content disabled; owners contacted; alerts; revocation by providers; push blocked or bypassed
incident_outcomes_available: DMCA notices public; secret alerts mostly private; public repo exposure can be observed externally
research_value_outcomes_available: research value weak; repository activity can be observed through GitHub APIs/GH Archive
denominators_available: public repositories and notices; denominator possible through GH Archive
potential_policy_events: March 2021 DMCA annotation change; secret scanning expansions 2024 and 2026
comparison_potential: good leakage-detection analogy and incident archive; weak for controlled-access data theory
next_steps: Use only as supplementary incident/detection source; avoid making it the main setting without denominator and privacy-specific exposure definition

name: HHS OCR Breach Portal
granularity_model: breach records not access tiers; entity/individuals affected/type/location
controls: HIPAA breach notification; OCR investigation; reporting threshold 500+ individuals
monitoring_or_logs: regulatory review/investigation; breach reports within last 24 months under investigation
post_access_actions: technical assistance; investigation closure; corrective action agreements possible
incident_outcomes_available: strong public incident registry for PHI breaches
denominators_available: incidents with affected counts; no denominator of projects/users
potential_policy_events: policy/reporting changes under HIPAA and Part 2 breach reporting
comparison_potential: good incident comparator only; not data-sharing project governance
next_steps: Use as leakage taxonomy and severity comparison; do not treat as main empirical setting

name: GitHub DMCA notices ecosystem
data_domain: software repositories source code packages documentation and related public URLs
granularity_model: notice-level records organized by date; repository URLs may be present; disabled content/fork-network annotations may appear; no controlled-access data tier
controls: DMCA takedown and counter-notice process; repository-owner opportunity to modify content in some cases; GitHub redaction and processing annotations
monitoring_or_logs: rights-holder notice submission; GitHub legal review; public posting after redaction; not a technical monitoring log
post_access_actions: content disabled; repository owner contacted; counter-notice; possible restoration after 10-14 days if no legal action; fork network processed in some cases
incident_outcomes_available: public notices and counter-notices are available; incident type is copyright/takedown not privacy leakage
research_value_outcomes_available: research value outcomes absent; repository activity and survival can be reconstructed separately if needed
denominators_available: notice files by year/month; commits; repository references where not redacted; denominator must be built from GitHub/GH Archive if used
potential_policy_events: March 2021 annotation change for owner-contact and fork-network processing notes
comparison_potential: valuable as a separate incident/takedown data ecosystem and detection-process analog; not a standalone test of controlled-access research data sharing
next_steps: In Phase 2 only do a lightweight field/format sample: parse years/months; identify fields; estimate redaction and repository-reference rates; decide whether it remains supplemental
